entities.summary: Shilpa Shetty (b. 1976-06-08, Mangaluru) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Mangaluru and India. Known in the fields of india, architects & designers, asia.
